scope: Exact geometry-member reconciliation including inherited and underscore-prefixed documented owners; full live object graph remains pending.
notice: Research only; existing standalone research notices retained.
languageMapping: Neutral model spellings retained. Length is an immutable finite safe-integer EMU value, not a number subclass; null is absence, not zero. Byte I/O operations are always async with supplied capabilities; XML/model-only access is synchronous. Booleans are strict and numeric strings rejected. No ambient host/file/network/native authority.
rounding: Lengths round nearest, ties away from zero. Shape rounded EMU bounds ±27273042316900 match CLI. Rotation rounds signed integer angle units before modulo; zero is explicit rot=0. Existing source normalization expectations retained without floating modulo noise.
securityMapping: Public XML is an admitted bounded XmlPart, not a host XML library. Non-sp geometry can be edited through applyShapeUpdate/mutateShapes; unsupported nongeometry edits reject. Inherited placeholders and document-owned returned subclass objects stay planned, not private.
